description: Create the three documentation artefacts: services/api-gateway/.env.example, root SETUP.md, and extend the root README.md. Independent of FEAT-001 — can be written without test results, though it should be implemented after FEAT-001 so the README testing section can reference actual test commands confirmed to work.
steps: Create services/api-gateway/.env.example. List every env variable used in the codebase with placeholder values and inline comments. Required variables: NODE_ENV=development, PORT=3000, DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/dalasmart, JWT_SECRET=change-me-in-production, CORS_ORIGIN=*, RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS=900000, RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS=100, ORS_API_KEY= (optional — leave blank to use fallback estimates), REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379, MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY=, MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET=, MPESA_PASSKEY=, MPESA_SHORTCODE=, MPESA_CALLBACK_URL=https://your-domain.com/api/v1/payments/webhook/mpesa, AIRTEL_CLIENT_ID=, AIRTEL_CLIENT_SECRET=, TIGO_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT=, TIGO_PIN=, HALOTEL_MERCHANT_CODE=, EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN= (for Expo push notifications), FCM_SERVER_KEY= (for Firebase push), LOG_LEVEL=info.

Create SETUP.md at repo root. Sections: Prerequisites (Node 20+, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+, Git); Clone & install (git clone, npm install at root); Environment setup (cp services/api-gateway/.env.example services/api-gateway/.env, edit JWT_SECRET and DATABASE_URL); Database setup (create database, cd services/api-gateway && npm run migrate && npm run seed); Start dev server (cd services/api-gateway && npm run dev — listens on :3000); Verify with smoke-test curl commands (GET /health, GET /api/v1/status); Run tests (cd services/api-gateway && npm test); Vercel deployment (link to vercel.json, vercel deploy command, required env vars to set in Vercel dashboard); Troubleshooting (DB connection refused — check DATABASE_URL and pg running; JWT error — check JWT_SECRET; port in use — set PORT env var).

Update README.md at repo root. READ the existing file first (already done during exploration — it has project description and monorepo structure). ADD the following sections without removing existing content: ## API Reference — table of all route prefixes (from src/routes/index.ts), auth required (yes/no), and one-line description; ## Environment Variables — reference to .env.example with brief descriptions of the three critical ones (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, ORS_API_KEY); ## Running Tests — `cd services/api-gateway && npm test` command; ## Deployment — brief Vercel/serverless note with link to SETUP.md; ## Troubleshooting — 5 common errors with solutions. Also update the Monorepo Structure section to reflect that api-gateway is the primary backend service (the README currently lists fleet-tracker, payment-service etc. as separate services which is the planned architecture but api-gateway is what is actually built).
acceptance_criteria: services/api-gateway/.env.example exists and contains at least 15 variable definitions with comments.
SETUP.md exists at repo root with at minimum 7 sections (Prerequisites, Clone, Environment, Database, Dev Server, Tests, Deployment).
README.md at repo root contains at least 8 ## headings after the update.
No secret values appear in any of the documentation files — only placeholders.
